description: The plot illustrates accuracy values across a sequence of discrete x-axis settings for two series with error bars. The x-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and shows integer tick marks from 1 to 19 at a regular interval of 2 (1, 3, 5, …, 19). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with regularly spaced ticks at 0.2 increments. One line is blue with circular markers and a dashed style, starting near 0.70 at x=1, rising to about 0.92 at x=3 and about 0.97 at x=5, staying around 0.95–1.00 through x=11 (including 1.00 at x=9 and x=11), dipping to about 0.90 at x=13, and returning to 1.00 at x=15, x=17, and x=19; it includes vertical error bars at each point. The other line is green with square markers and a solid style, starting near 0.36 at x=1, increasing to about 0.45 at x=3, about 0.61 at x=5, and about 0.68 at x=7, dropping to about 0.45 at x=9, rising to about 0.67 at x=11, decreasing to about 0.60 at x=13 and about 0.50 at x=15, then increasing to 1.00 at x=17 and remaining at 1.00 at x=19; it also shows vertical error bars at each point.
